title: Disqualification About Tourney

replies.author: faht
replies.body:
• Autoclicker / Illegal modifications

    • First Offense → Player disqualified, Player permanent banned on ALL Avicus services, match loss for all matches that there is evidence of the player using the client modification.

    • Second Offense → Player permanent banned on ALL Avicus services, team disqualified & blacklisted.

      Next time, use this thread if you have any questions about the tournament.
